author: Play On Tabletop
description:
The Conquest of the Colosseums is brought to you by Baron of Dice! https://baronofdice.com/?ref=PiWj5cSTlKyTsZ Get your dice, tape measures, and more from Baron of Dice.

3 Colosseums Must Be Conquered! In order to be crowned King in this new season of King of the Colosseum a force must get a win in all three Colosseums: Jungle, Ocean, and Ruined City. However, one loss and the force is banished forever. 

Nick has entered the fight! He brings the Astra Militarum in his bid to conquer the Colosseums. Opposing him is Garry with the Imperial Agents who look to claim the prize for themselves and ensure no other Imperium force knows of the power they look to obtain. 

In this season's King of the Colosseum fights each episode is a best of 3 with only one force able to move on to other battles while the loser is banished from this season. To earn the right to fight for the crown, each force must win at all three different Colosseums: Jungle, Ocean, and Ruined City. Who will be crowned king
title: Astra Militarum vs Imperial Agents. King of the Colosseum Game 2
